LLM TOPOLOGY / R020 / RELATIONAL EVIDENCE

512 state-level semantic networks

Pythia 70M · 32 generated-token decisions · 8 internal states · positive and negative cosine sectors. This report visualises measured community connections and structure-first groupings. It deliberately retains mixed and uninterpretable vocabulary rather than forcing every node into a semantic parent.

Pairwise Jaccard uses the union of representative token IDs, not full membership. The same-token group contains 26 pairs; the different-token group contains 470 pairs at each state/sector. All comparisons come from the same continuation and are not independent experiments.

How to read the maps

Nodes are the original measured communities with representative tokens. Their area loosely reflects the measured selected-vocabulary population.

Links indicate measured cross-community nearest-neighbour token connections. The display uses up to three strongest links incident to each community; other links remain in the original measurement.

Colours indicate graph-derived structural modules determined by connectivity, not semantically validated topics. Modules may contain incompatible subjects or tokenizer fragments.

S00 is an input-token embedding, so a recognisable association at S00 is not evidence of newly inferred contextual information. S01–S05 show contextual states; S06/S07 are raw final-block and final-normalised states.

Negative cosine describes anti-aligned projections, not conceptual suppression. No single network is evidence of a causal reasoning chain or a recovered training document.

Provenance: measured chatgpt_community_networks.json from R020, with four checkpointed eight-decision relational map datasets and separately saved cross-state matches. The original measured networks, community IDs and representative vocabulary remain the authority. The intended final use is independent human judgement of the reconstruction's usefulness.
